nodes.label: INTENT.md — Project Purpose & Operational Intent
nodes.rationale: Addresses fragmented one-off operator scripts and human errors in production by standardizing PowerShell 7 and .NET 10 utilities under a Safe-by-Default AI-Native SDLC.

nodes.label: C# .NET 10 3-Tier UI Platform Selection Criteria
nodes.rationale: Selects between Tier 1 Pure CLI, Tier 2 CLI+WinForms Hybrid, and Tier 3 WPF MVVM while avoiding WinUI 3 because Windows App SDK/MSIX dependencies fail on air-gapped or remote Windows Server environments.
